summary: Tested Minute backend (FastAPI LLM proxy + Node bridge) and the React control dashboard against the public preview URL. 6/6 pytest backend tests pass: /api/health (ok/model claude-sonnet-4-6/llm_configured), /api/llm/complete (real Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent key returned 'PONG', system-prompt variant, 422 validation), /api/minute/overview (up, githubConfigured, surfaces.discord true, playground llmwatermarking -> Aditya-Sarna/llmwatermarking with allowPaths incl. frontend/src/), /api/minute/runs (runs array, no bridge error). Dashboard renders fully: brand 'minute', status pills (Service live, LLM claude-sonnet-4-6, GitHub on, Discord on, Slack off as expected), Loop stepper (6 steps), Playgrounds card with repo link, People & rails, Runs card (empty state). Live polling confirmed (3 /api calls per 5s cycle). No console errors, no error banners. Discord slash-command / GitHub PR flows were NOT tested per instruction.

minor.issue: Bridge failures are swallowed and returned as HTTP 200 with {up:false,error} / {runs:[],error}; a 502/503 would be more correct for monitoring.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Requesters' row renders overview.admins.discordUserIds (copy/paste bug) — the Node /internal/overview payload does not expose cfg.requesters at all, so requester allowlist is misreported as the admin list.

issues: Playgrounds card has a large empty bottom area (height matched to People card) — looks unbalanced on 1920px width
Pill labels (SERVICE/GITHUB/DISCORD) are low-contrast dim grey on near-black; readable but below AA for small caps text

action_items: Fix 'Requesters' row in /app/frontend/src/App.js to use a requesters field, and expose cfg.requesters in /internal/overview (src/index.ts)
Optional: return non-200 from /api/minute/* when the Node bridge is unreachable
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is clean and env-driven; no hardcoded URLs, MONGO not used (no persistence needed) — OK.
src/protocol.ts (336 lines) and other modules are all <700 lines — OK.
Frontend dashboard has no loading skeleton: before first fetch resolves, pills render as 'down/—' which can momentarily look like an outage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Discord/GitHub write flows intentionally untested. Node service on 8787 exposes /internal/overview and /internal/runs.
rca_of_the_issue: Requesters bug: App.js line 170 passes overview?.admins?.discordUserIds to the Requesters PeopleRow; the backend overview object has only 'admins' and 'tech' keys, so no requester data reaches the UI.
